back: A catalyst in a different phase from the reactants (e.g. solid Fe with gaseous N₂ and H₂).
A catalyst in the same phase as the reactants; used in one step, regenerated in a later one.
Adsorption → weakening of bonds → reaction on the surface → desorption of products.
Pt/Pd/Rh: 2CO + 2NO → 2CO₂ + N₂; CO → CO₂; hydrocarbons → CO₂ + H₂O.
Strongly adsorbed impurities block active sites: lead in converters, sulfur compounds on Haber iron.

front: NO₂ and SO₂ in the atmosphere
back: SO₂ + NO₂ → SO₃ + NO; NO + ½O₂ → NO₂ (homogeneous catalysis).
The catalyst's E⦵ must lie between those of the two reacting couples so both steps are feasible.
MnO₂ catalyses 2H₂O₂ → 2H₂O + O₂; recovered unchanged in mass.
